nodes.label: desktop memory index - the always-on rules and the design/project entries as the desktop believed them

Frozen copy taken 2026-08-03 of the desktop machine's memory file - the live directory sits on the other machine and is not reachable from here, so this copy is what there is to review. Listed unreviewed in REVIEW_REGISTER.md section 6. The index opens by stating the repo is now just v3, a self-contained HERB evaluation harness, with v1/ and v2/ deleted 2026-06-23 and their source surviving in git history, and the artefact arm's design retained to be rebuilt natively in v3. Its always-on 'How I work' list: heed user intent and do not correct it; lock concept language; match output to the ask; prompts are context, reconcile first; verify before asserting; check what exists before adding; no cutting corners; no silent fallbacks; delete, do not preserve; no fabricated offline checks; user owns execution; no historical or defensive comments. CANON_AUDIT.md calls this the best-attributed surface in the project - roughly 30 of its entries carry an explicit user quote in a 'Canonical user-established facts' slot, and several files name their own agent inventions and kill them; the surface adjudicates at 30 claims, 19 GROUNDED, 3 AGENT-ORIGIN, 1 CONTRADICTS-USER, 7 STALE
